title: A person's placement or drop of one item
description: What POST /api/v1/review/{key}/place and /api/v1/review/{key}/drop answer, and `ingestion review place --json` and `review drop --json` print. A placement's body names its destination, and either body may name a cause and a note. A service's body also names the login of the person it decides for. Sent again with the same body, either answers the decisions the first made and appends none.

key.description: The item's key, which a URL in the path resolves to.

decisions.description: The side decision, decided by person:<login>, then the read decision where the destination takes a side.
